crossRefs.note: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.
Yahweh will render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; because Yahweh delivered you into my hand…
then hear in heaven, and act, and judge your servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way on his own head, and…
Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have delivered him who without cause was my adversary),
Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that…
Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that…
Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

parallels.note: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

translations.web: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.
translations.bsb: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
translations.kjv: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
translations.asv: Jehovah rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
